body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung presented ‘SVP-56K3HDB’, the first ACAP(Advanced Common Application Platform) DLP TV during KES 2006, which supports two-day data broadcasting service.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
